title: Lark Social Realm Plus 2
description: The Lark Social Realm Plus 2 is a Signature-original social realm in the platforms family. It tracks the working profile of Horizon Worlds — social VR platform: user-built virtual worlds with avatar presence. Introduced in 2021, it serves VR creators.

demo.title: Interactive record tour — Lark Social Realm Plus 2
